2022 Q2.bq: Our Q2 revenue was above the high end of our guidance range as we navigated the China lockdown and recovered the impacted revenue late in the second quarter.

2023 Q1.bq: Total revenue was $1.96 billion dollars above the midpoint of our guidance driven by strength in silicon carbide and energy infrastructure.

2023 Q2.bq: We grew revenue 7% sequentially, expanded gross margin by 60 basis points to 47.4%, and delivered a 12% quarter-over-quarter increase in earnings per share to $1.33, which exceeded our guidance range.

2023 Q3.bq: Non-GAAP earnings per diluted share was near the high end of our guidance at $1.39 as compared to $1.45 in Q3 of 2022.

2023 Q4.bq: For the fourth quarter, we reported revenue of $2.02 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 46.7% and non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.25, all above the midpoint of our guidance.

2024 Q2.bq: Our Q2 results exceeded the midpoint of our guidance with revenue of $1.74 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 45.3%, non-GAAP operating margin of 27.5%, and 12% free cash flow margin.

2024 Q3.bq: Our third quarter results once again demonstrated the structural changes we have made to the business with revenue, gross margin, and earnings per share all above the midpoint of our guidance.

2025 Q1.bq: We exceeded the midpoint of our guidance with revenue of $1.45 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of $0.55, while Q1 free cash flow increased 72% year-over-year.

2025 Q3.bq: Our third quarter results exceeded the midpoint of our guidance with revenue of $1.55 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 38%, and earnings per share towards the high end of our range at $0.63.

2025 Q4.bq: Turning to the demand environment, we are seeing seasonal patterns and are encouraged by improving order trends across our core markets, contributing to fourth quarter revenue of $1.53 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 38.2%, and earnings per share of $0.64, both exceeding the midpoint of our guidance.

2026 Q1.bq: We delivered revenue of $1.51 billion, better than normal seasonality, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $0.64, both above the midpoint of our guidance.

2026 Q2.bq: In Q2, we delivered $1.6 billion of revenue, non-GAAP gross margin of 39.3% and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.74, all above the midpoint of our guidance.

2026 Q3.bq: Q3 revenue was $1.72 billion, above the midpoint of our guidance and up 7% sequentially.
